headline.text: L1 S3 Matrix residue found at startup after *4 allergen test failures* on Russel Finex — re-cleans completed, all passed by shift end.

summary: Five sanitation gaps across L1 — heavy cream pipe clogged from missed clean, metal detector failed visual, Matrix molds had residue at startup. All re-cleaned and released. Label quality issues on L1 S2 and S4; BOM error caused ingredient shortage on S4.

food_safety.title: Metal detector keyhole damaged, reject bin access compromised
food_safety.summary: S3 metal detector keyhole damaged — someone forced it open instead of using key; maintenance removed keyhole, line now stops for every MD check until repaired.
food_safety.status: Open — keyhole removed, line stops for checks; padlock functional per 1st shift tech but broken per maintenance.

quality.title: S4 container label mismatch — butter type unknown
quality.summary: Container labeled item 10218 but contains butter of unknown type; QA and IMS notified at 15:23.

quality.title: S4 BOM error lists wrong ingredients for sugar free caramel
quality.summary: Work order for item 20025 (sugar free) contained BOM for 20009 (regular); caused 140 lb evaporated milk shortage, schedule pushed to next day.
quality.status: New WO created, milk ordered ETA 12:30 pm 10/6.

quality.title: S2 jar label wrinkles from defective roll stock
quality.summary: Label machine applying wrinkled labels; inspection found lines on some rolls causing wrinkles; defective rolls replaced, issue resolved by 11:57.
quality.status: Resolved — defective rolls replaced, labels now clean.

quality.title: S1 final piece chocolate coverage low, weight at upper limit
quality.summary: Final pieces insufficient chocolate on bottom; operator cited weight spec concern (current 6.07g, max 6.07g); QA flagged appearance issue at 12:48.
quality.status: Open — operator declined adjustment citing weight limit.

quality.title: FFS bags sealing open
quality.summary: Bags coming out open at 14:53; machine cleaned, line restarted.

quality.title: ML2 broken bar rate 16 per minute
quality.summary: QA counted 16 broken bars in one minute at 22:15; demolding hammers and twist adjusted, improvement requested.
quality.status: Adjustments made at 00:22 — follow-up count pending.

quality.title: ML4 cookie weight 11% over target on first run
quality.summary: Long loop cookie first check 1.62g vs 1.46g target (11% high); R&D consulted for recipe adjustment.
quality.status: Open — R&D reviewing, additional checks planned.

sanitation.title: Hapman lids & cones require 3x reclean with APC swab
sanitation.summary: Plant Standards: Hapman lids & cones flagged for reclean 3 times with APC swab after each clean; isolated for recleaning 1st shift 10/6.
sanitation.status: Scheduled for recleaning 1st shift 10/6, isolation confirmed.

sanitation.title: S3 metal detector failed visual inspection
sanitation.summary: 3rd shift sent maintenance to assemble MD but QA failed visual; re-cleaned, ATP and allergen swab completed before assembly.

sanitation.title: S3 Matrix 3/4/5 residue found at setup, paper covering noted
sanitation.summary: Operators found cookie/product residue on pouch arms, bottomer, internal areas during mold rotation; paper coverings on machines origin unknown; re-cleaned, ATP all 0, allergen passed by 04:49.
sanitation.status: Resolved — re-clean complete, ATP 0, allergen passed.

sanitation.title: S2 capper belt required level 2 clean after repair
sanitation.summary: Capper belt repaired; QA required level 2 clean before use, ATP tested and approved at 07:52.

sanitation.title: S4 heavy cream pipe clogged — missed clean previous day
sanitation.summary: Heavy cream pipe clogged at startup 11:07; crew reported pipe not cleaned yesterday, causing 29-minute delay.

allergen.title: S3 MM3 checkweigher & x-ray belts failed allergen test
allergen.summary: Checkweigher and x-ray belts for MM3 failed allergen testing during overnight clean; re-cleaned, status included in summary report that MM4 & MM5 passed.
allergen.status: Re-cleaned — final status not explicitly confirmed in window.

allergen.title: S3 Russel Finex failed allergen test 4 times
allergen.summary: Non-allergen system Russel Finex filter failed allergen testing 4 times starting 23:54; eventually re-cleaned and passed at 01:07.
allergen.status: Resolved — passed on 5th attempt after re-clean.

opportunities.text: Consider adding post-shift cleaning verification to S4 startup checklist — today's heavy cream pipe clog from missed clean caused 29-minute delay and echoes similar gaps on S3 Matrix residue.
Review label and BOM quality control at release — S2 jar labels (defective roll stock), S4 container label (item mismatch), and S4 BOM error (wrong ingredients) all reached production floor.
Investigate ML2 demolding process consistency — 16 broken bars per minute at 22:15 suggests mechanical or recipe issue worth root-causing.
Consider trial-batch weight verification before full ML4 production runs — today's long loop cookie 11% over target on first check.
